summary: c1 is a newly introduced startup incompatibility: the old harness satisfies the before-source startup order but not the after-source order.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the former buffer initialization behavior.
Shows the moved callback and new MyProc check.
Shows where the buffer callback was formerly registered.
Shows the revised InitPostgres path without that call.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established this execution-compatibility obligation for the target's actual standalone initializer.

before.requirement: Call BaseInit to create standalone shared memory through InitCommunication; then call InitProcess to acquire MyProc and InitPostgres to register the buffer exit callback.
before.reason: The unchanged harness calls BaseInit, InitProcess and InitPostgres in that order. Before the change, BaseInit itself invokes the standalone shared-memory helper, and InitPostgres performs the later buffer-manager initialization.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the former standalone shared-memory helper.
Shows the former InitBufferPoolBackend call after InitProcess.
Unchanged InitProcess requires ProcGlobal and acquires MyProc.

after.requirement: Create standalone shared memory, call InitProcess to acquire MyProc, and only then call BaseInit and InitPostgres.
after.reason: BaseInit no longer creates shared memory and now checks MyProc; InitBufferPoolAccess also checks MyProc and registers the callback. The harness still calls BaseInit before InitProcess and never calls CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores, so InitProcess would PANIC on its NULL ProcGlobal check even when assertions are disabled.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the new buffer initialization requirement and moved callback.
Shows InitPostgres now follows earlier process setup.
Unchanged InitProcess PANIC and MyProc acquisition behavior.
The updated standalone PostgresMain demonstrates the required order.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the initializer precedes every fuzz input.
Shows the named fuzzer links the manual initializer.

claims.comparison_reason: The concrete old-harness sequence is unchanged. It worked before because BaseInit created shared memory and InitPostgres performed the later buffer initialization. After the change, those responsibilities moved ahead of BaseInit, so the same sequence fails. There is no common before-and-after blocker for c1.
